title: Lift an algebraic-space geometric point over a specified etale chart point
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $X,U$ be algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], and let $e:U\to X$ be an etale morphism, meaning a representable map whose base change by every scheme over $X$ is etale [def-trf-algebraic-space, def-weil-etale-morphism]. For an algebraic space $Z$, let $|Z|$ be the set of equivalence classes of field-valued points $\operatorname{Spec}L\to Z$, where two such points are equivalent if their maps agree over a common field extension. Let $\Omega$ be an algebraically closed field and $\bar x:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to X$ a geometric point, and write $x\in|X|$ for its image. For every $u\in|U|$ with $e(u)=x$, there is $\bar u:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to U$ with image $u$ and $e\bar u=\bar x$. In particular the field $\Omega$ need not be enlarged.

proof.text: Put $T=\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$ and form the sheaf fibre product $P=T\times_XU$, with projections $a:P\to T$ and $b:P\to U$. By the definition of a representable etale map in [def-trf-algebraic-space], $P$ is represented by a scheme and $a$ is etale: these are precisely the requirements on the base change of $e$ by the scheme map $\bar x:T\to X$. The fibre-product identity is $e\circ b=\bar x\circ a$.

source.place: Tag 05VN, lemma-geometric-lift-to-usual, proof; Tag 03H4, lemma-points-cartesian, proof.

proof.text: Choose a field-valued representative v of u. First verify that the common-field relation defining point classes is an equivalence: reflexivity and symmetry are immediate; for transitivity, take the scheme pullback of the two common field spectra over the middle field spectrum. Mathlib Scheme.exists_preimage_of_isPullback gives a point because the middle spectrum has one point; the residue field of this pullback point gives the common extension and the pullback equation gives agreement of restrictions. Thus Quot.eqvGen_exact applied to e(u) = [xbar] supplies one common-field witness. Evaluate the representing pullback square from step 1 on that field spectrum. Types.exists_of_isPullback gives a map j into the representing scheme P whose composite with b is the restriction of v. Put p = j(default). The class of b at p is u: any field-valued scheme map factors through the residue field of its image, and this factorization witnesses equality with schemePointMap.

source.place: Tag 05VN, lemma-geometric-lift-to-usual, proof; Tag 03H4, lemma-points-cartesian, proof.

proof.text: Apply Scheme.exists_fac_of_etale_of_isSepClosed from [lem-weil-pbc-etale-cover-geometric-point-lift] directly to the etale projection a:P→Spec Ω, the identity of Spec Ω, and p. The required equality of image points holds because Spec Ω has one point. Algebraic closedness implies separable closedness. The lemma gives l:Spec Ω→P with l≫a=id and l(default)=p. The structure map identity for a makes l a map over S.

source.place: Tag 03PR, lemma-geometric-lift-to-cover; prescribed-point form from Morphisms Tag 02GL, lemma-etale-over-field, as stated in the cited Mathlib leaf.

proof.text: Set ubar = yoneda.map(l)≫b. The representing square and l≫a=id imply ubar≫e=xbar. Factor both the field-valued map l and the temporary common-field map j through the residue fields of their image points; since their images are both p, their composites with b have the same point class. The latter class equals u by the common-field witness from step 2. The source of ubar is the original Spec Ω, so the temporary common extension does not enlarge its field.
